name: FilmStripScrubber
job: Browse photos on a sprocketed film strip where the frame under a fixed viewing window enlarges as you scrub
visitor_action: drag, swipe or scroll the strip sideways; arrow keys step; click a frame to bring it under the window
mobile: strip below the large frame, swipe scrubs
motion: strip glides with momentum, centre frame scales up with spring (reduced-motion: snap steps, no scale)
art_direction: Cutting room: smoke-grey acetate strip, amber frame numbers, cool studio-white viewer, matte finish
